title: Panel: Graphite & Anodes Outside China: What It Actually Takes to Get Built
gist: Member-only video page for a Giga Africa 2026 panel on building graphite and anode capacity outside China; the extracted text contains only speaker names and the conference agenda, no substantive discussion.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, Falcon Energy Materials and Total Graphite held a 25:52 panel on 2 Oct 2026 at Giga Africa 2026 on what it actually takes to build graphite and anode capacity outside China.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Matthieu Bos , President & CEO , Falcon Energy Mat
insights.so_what: Signals industry attention on non-China graphite/anode supply chains; the transcript is member-only, so the substance is not available from this page.
insights.quote: Panel: Graphite & Anodes Outside China: What It Actually Takes to Get Built

insights.claim: The panel brought together a consultant (Shruti Kashyap, Benchmark), a producer-side executive (Matthieu Bos, Falcon Energy Materials CEO) and a graphite miner's sales head (Harshit Poddar, Total Graphite), spanning anode developers and African graphite supply.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Matthieu Bos , President & CEO , Falcon Energy Mat
insights.so_what: Watch Falcon Energy Materials and Total Graphite as African/ex-China graphite supply names.

insights.claim: The Giga Africa 2026 agenda also covered a graphite commodity update, a copper outlook, Africa's battery storage pipeline, lithium supply chains and an integrated LFP battery supply chain in Africa, indicating Africa is being positioned as a battery-materials region.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Matthieu Bos , President & CEO , Falcon Energy Mat
insights.so_what: Conference themes suggest investor interest in African battery-materials value chains beyond mining, including LFP integration.
insights.quote: Is the Time Right for an Integrated LFP Battery Supply Chain in Africa?

source_meta.author: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Matthieu Bos , President & CEO , Falcon Energy Mat
